title_sq: Okazion Kleringu!Tek Urban Gate, Shitet Apartament 1+1 Me Planimetri Perfekte!!!
description_sq: Okazion Kleringu!Tek Urban Gate, Shitet Apartament 1+1 Me Planimetri Perfekte! Apartamenti me siperfaqe totale 80 m2 ndodhet ne katin e 9 te nje kompleksi, objekt banimi 7-10 kate me 2 kate parkim nentoke dhe organizohet nga korridori i cili ben shperndarjen ne sallonin e ndenjes se bashku me kendin e gatimit me dalje ne ballkon, dhomen e gjumit dhe nje tualet. Kompleksi dallohet per punimet teper cilesore duke filluar nga instalimet hidraulike-elektrike, termoizolim me fasade te ventiluar, shtrimi me pllake ose parket sipas deshires se klientit, dritaret dopioxham termike , hapesira pushimi dhe hapesira te gjelberta perreth kompleksit te cilat do te kryhen nga Shoqeria "Urban Planning & Development" shpk.
title_en: Clearing opportunity! At Urban Gate, 1+1 apartment for sale with perfect floor plan!!!
description_en: Clearing opportunity! At Urban Gate, 1+1 apartment for sale with perfect floor plan! The apartment with a total area of ​​80 m2 is located on the 9th floor of a complex, a residential building of 7-10 floors with 2 floors of underground parking and is organized by the corridor which divides the living room together with the kitchen corner with access to the balcony, the bedroom and a toilet. The complex stands out for its high-quality works, starting from the hydraulic-electrical installations, thermal insulation with ventilated facades, paving with tiles or parquet according to the customer's wishes, thermal double-glazed windows, rest areas and green spaces around the complex which will be carried out by Soqeria "Urban Planning & Development" shpk.
